summary: General ansible-navigator settings include ansible-runner-artifact-dir (--rad), ansible-runner-rotate-artifacts-count (--rac, 0 keeps all), ansible-runner-timeout (--rt), app (entry point such as collections, run or welcome, default welcome) and cmdline (extra parameters passed to the command), each with an ANSIBLE_NAVIGATOR_* environment variable and settings-file key.
questions: How do I set the ansible-runner artifact directory for ansible-navigator?
How do I limit how many ansible-runner artifact directories navigator keeps?
How do I set a timeout for ansible-navigator runs?
What is the default app for ansible-navigator?
